title: Hearty American Shungiku Roast
description: A savory roast featuring tender pork shoulder, the earthy flavor of shungiku leaves, and a crisp paleo puff pastry crust, baked in a terracotta dish for a rustic finish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a terracotta dish with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, mix sea salt, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, and rosemary to create a dry rub.
Pat the pork shoulder dry with paper towels and coat it generously with coconut oil, then rub the seasoning mix all over the meat.
Place the sliced onions, carrots, and shungiku leaves at the bottom of the terracotta dish to form a bed for the roast.
Position the seasoned pork shoulder on top of the vegetable bed, fat side up, and pour 200 ml of water into the dish.
Cover the pork shoulder with a sheet of paleo puff pastry, sealing the edges by pressing them together to lock in moisture.

Roast the covered pork shoulder in the preheated oven for 1 hour, then remove the pastry cover and continue roasting for another 30 minutes until the pastry turns golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C) for pork.
Remove the dish from the oven and let the roast rest for 15 minutes before slicing.
Slice the pork shoulder into thick, juicy pieces, and arrange them on a serving platter.
Serve the roast hot, garnished with a few fresh shungiku leaves and a drizzle of cooked broth from the dish.
